html:
A singer from Mindelo on Sao Vicente, known as the barefoot diva, who took morna to world audiences from the late 1980s.

She sang in the bars of Mindelo as a young woman and stopped for about a decade before a Paris label recorded her in her late forties. Her album Miss Perfumado (1992) made her famous, and she won a Grammy in 2004. She sang only in Creole and always performed barefoot, it is said in solidarity with the poor. For many people abroad she was their first knowledge of Cape Verde, and its airport on Sao Vicente is named after her.
sum: A singer from Mindelo on Sao Vicente, known as the barefoot diva, who took morna to world audiences from the late 1980s.
